cohort: Singleton pregnancies experiencing PPROM between 34-37 weeks of gestation at Jehangir Hospital, Pune, and Maharashtra, from January 2016 to September 2017.
finding: Maternal complications following PPROM between 34-37 weeks gestation were infrequent, and neonatal outcomes, such as Apgar scores and NICU admission, varied with gestational age at PPROM.
